items.t: Air suspension compressor failure
items.job: Replace air suspension compressor
items.note: Owners report about $1,200-$1,500 installed. Fix any air leaks at the same time.

items.t: Air springs leak and the SUV sags
items.job: Replace leaking air springs (per axle) and recalibrate height
items.note: Owners report around $1,000 for rear springs and shocks; front struts cost more. Height sensors add $100-$250 each.

items.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners (both banks)
items.note: Specialists quote about $4,500-$7,500 CAD if caught early; a replacement engine runs far more.

items.t: Coolant leak from plastic crossover pipes
items.job: Replace coolant crossover pipes (intake or supercharger removal)
items.note: Owners report $400-$3,000 depending on shop and engine; specialists quote $1,800-$3,200 CAD.

items.t: Water pump or thermostat housing leak
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing
items.note: RepairPal estimates a water pump at roughly $670-$1,340 depending on year.

items.t: Supercharger coupler rattle at idle
items.job: Replace supercharger snout isolator (coupler)
items.note: A full snout rebuild costs more if the bearings are damaged.

items.t: Supercharger coolant pump failure
items.job: Replace supercharger (intercooler) coolant pump
items.note: One owner paid about $600.

items.t: Worn front control arm bushings and ball joints
items.job: Replace both front lower control arms and align
items.note: Owners report $1,000-$1,800.

items.t: Parking brake screeches or won't release
items.job: Replace electronic parking brake actuator and adjust cables
items.note: One owner paid about $950 for the actuator together with other parts.

items.t: Rear brakes wear out quickly
items.job: Replace rear brake pads and rotors

items.t: Battery drain and no-start
items.job: Parasitic draw test and battery replacement
items.note: RepairPal estimates a battery at about $140-$1,220 depending on year; mild hybrids cost the most.

items.t: Door won't lock or latch
items.job: Replace one door latch with lock motor
items.note: Parts are genuine latch prices for 2014-2022 models (LR078728 about $310 from a UK supplier, LR078706 $349 from a US seller); 2006-2013 latches differ. YourMechanic: $740-$911 total per door (2008-2018), $860-$1,580 at shops and dealers.

items.t: Oil or transmission cooler line leak
items.job: Replace leaking oil or transmission cooler line
items.note: YourMechanic used as the basis (no parts-catalog price found): oil cooler lines $262-$751 and transmission cooler hose $504-$849 total, depending on year and engine. Add fluid top-up or a transmission service if a lot was lost.
